description: [LocalSim L3 / DEPENDS ON L1 BUG-462] live_session.py: (a) save_order_execution_state (1715, bar cursor) is persisted BEFORE save_cash_entry (1749) under autocommit -> a crash between them advances the bar cursor (bars never reprocessed) while the cash debit is never written = permanent under-charge / NAV overstatement. (b) a no-fill/hold day raises and _mark_run_failed flips run AND portfolio to FAILED (1830/1892) instead of NO_REBALANCE/SUCCEEDED (simulation_runtime path already models no_rebalance as success). (c) a non-retryable TDX tick error re-raises leaving the PaperRun RUNNING (148/382) with no LocalSim cutoff terminalizer. FIX (build on L1 transaction): make the cursor advance commit atomically with the cash/position effect; model a no-fill/no-actionable-intent day as SUCCEEDED/NO_REBALANCE without failing the portfolio; on terminal TDX tick failure mark the run FAILED before propagating + add a LocalSim post-cutoff terminalize. Must NOT weaken BUG-448 status guards. MiniQMT untouched.
